_about: Coverage floors and dead-code baseline for the firmware Rust workspace. Established by Phase 03 Task 02 (the adopting task). Floors only ever tighten, never loosen (EXECUTION-ETHICS.md §D). Enforced by `make coverage-ratchet` via ci/check_coverage_ratchet.py + cargo-llvm-cov. The phase that adds a new crate must add its measured floor here; check_coverage_ratchet.py fails if a workspace package has no floor entry.

dead_code._about: Zero dead code is enforced directly by `make cargo-clippy` (-D dead_code); this baseline records the ratcheted allowance.
